paper_title: Can We Edit LLMs for Long-Tail Biomedical Knowledge
caption: : The performance on Llama3.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the change in accuracy percentage (ACC) against the number of co-occurrences. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number", using a exponential scale with values ranging from 0 to slightly above 1000, and tick labels at 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, and numeric tick intervals of 5%. The plot contains six lines: a black line with circular markers (Base) starts near 61% at 5 and trends upwards, ending just above 66% bit beyond 10^3. The blue line with downward-pointing triangle markers (FT) starts near 62% at 5 and increases, ending slightly above 68% bit beyond 10^3. The red line with upward-pointing triangle markers (IKE) begins around 64% at 5 and increases, reaching just under 69% bit beyond 10^3. The brown line with diamond markers (MEND) starts at around 66% at 5 and rises to close to 73% bit beyond 10^3. The purple line with pentagon markers (MEMIT) begins near 66% and increases to approximately 72% bit beyond 10^3. The green line with square markers (ROME) initiates near 73% at 5 and trends upwards, ending at about 77% bit beyond 10^3. Each line exhibits a generally upward trend across the x-axis range. There are 4 markers in each line. A legend is given in top left, describing the line and color.
